publications.title: STEAM: Securing the connections in wireless sensor networks with varying target priority
publications.abstract: We formalize the Q-Secure Connectivity problem, which extends Q-Connectivity by enforcing target-dependent secure communication ranges to prevent eavesdropping. We propose STEAM (Sensor Tree Establishment and Adjacency Mapping), a graph-based heuristic that builds a minimum spanning tree over targets and applies a Hungarian-based mapping to construct node-disjoint, secure paths with few relay nodes. On realistic 3D datasets, STEAM uses 3× fewer relay nodes and is 15× faster than the state of the art, with 30% lower energy use, 20% lower outage probability, 40% lower latency and 50% higher throughput.

publications.title: MERIT: Multimodal Enhanced Retrieval through Instruction-level Transformer-based Chunking in Product Manuals
publications.venue: 2025 International Conference on Digital Economy and Fintech Innovation (DEFI 2025), Da Nang, Vietnam
publications.abstract: MERIT is a multimodal question-answering framework for product manuals. It segments manuals into fine-grained instruction chunks and encodes them with a Mixture-of-Experts Q-Former that fuses textual summaries with graphical features. Trained with a contrastive objective, it builds a unified embedding space for dense retrieval; a vision-language model then generates visually grounded answers. On PM209, MERIT improves retrieval precision and answer quality over state-of-the-art baselines.
